-- Migración: Sistema de Alertas Tempranas de Riesgo Psicosocial
-- Fecha: 2026-02-24

-- Tabla de historial de alertas de riesgo
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `risk_alert_history` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `department_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `alert_type` ENUM('high_risk_threshold_exceeded', 'medium_risk_threshold_exceeded', 'manual_alert', 'critical_case') NOT NULL,
  `risk_percentage` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Porcentaje de empleados en riesgo alto',
  `threshold` VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Umbral configurado que se superó',
  `total_employees` INT NOT NULL,
  `high_risk_employees` INT NOT NULL,
  `triggered_by` INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuario que disparó la alerta',
  `triggered_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `notification_sent` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `notes` TEXT,
  INDEX `idx_alert_department` (`department_id`),
  INDEX `idx_alert_type` (`alert_type`),
  INDEX `idx_alert_triggered_at` (`triggered_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de configuración de umbrales por departamento
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `risk_alert_thresholds` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `department_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `high_risk_threshold` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30 COMMENT 'Porcentaje umbral para riesgo alto (%)',
  `medium_risk_threshold` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 20 COMMENT 'Porcentaje umbral para riesgo medio (%)',
  `enable_auto_alerts` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  `created_by` INT NOT NULL,
  `updated_by` INT NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_department_threshold` (`department_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
